title: Hydration mismatch when using the `useId` hook, when using the `app/` router

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information ```bash Operating System: Platform: darwin Arch: arm64 Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.4.0: Mon Mar 6 20:59:28 PST 2023; root:xnu-8796.101.5~3/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000 Binaries: Node: 18.16.0 npm: 9.5.1 Yarn: 1.22.19 pnpm: 8.6.1 Relevant Packages: next: 13.4.12-canary.0 eslint-config-next: 13.4.12 react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 typescript: 5.1.6 Next.js Config: output: N/A ``` ### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure) App Router ### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug https://github.com/RobinMalfait/server-client-mismatch-example ### To Reproduce This only happens when using the `app/` router, not when using the `pages` directory. When you run the reproduction repo (`next dev`) and open your browser, then the warning is available in your console. ### Describe the Bug When using the `useId` hook result in on of the attributes or as the contents of an element, then a mismatch is shown. ``` Warning: Prop `data-id` did not match. Server: ":R1mcq:" Client: ":R6pj9:" ``` The following code should be enough to reproduce this: ```js "use client"; import {useId} from "react" export function Example() { let id = useId() return
My Example
} ``` ### Expected Behavior I expect that no mismatch issue is happening. ### Which browser are you using? (if relevant) _No response_ ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) _No response_ [NEXT-1470](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-1470/hydration-mismatch-when-using-the-useid-hook-when-using-the-app-router)
